occurrences.englishText: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him.
“Return, backsliding children,” says Yahweh; “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.
Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding.
My people have been lost sheep.
